Map-generation fixtures
=======================

Fixtures in this tree must state their edition/profile, seed, difficulty, act,
area, and source. The goal is to compare native Rust generation against
known-good output from a D2-runtime extractor without requiring live packet
capture or a local Diablo II install during ordinary tests.

Current profile directories:

- `lod_1_14d`: fixtures treated as Lord of Destruction 1.14d targets.
